author: Unity
description:
In Black Jacket, made with Unity, gamble your way out of hell in this blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deckbuilder. Play powerful card combos or cheat to outwit your opponents and earn your freedom. Win their Soul coins! Bribe the ferryman! And uncover the story of those who stand in your way.

Developed by: Alt Shift
Published by: Dotemu

Check out the game: https://on.unity.com/PlayBlackJacket
Learn more and submit your project: https://on.unity.com/MWU
Discover more Unity-powered games: https://on.unity.com/MWU-Steam

#MadeWithUnity #UnityGames #Unity #BlackJacket
